judge.rationale: The candidate only produced a planning document (`.lore/dod.md`) and a new acceptance test file, without actually modifying `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`, `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, or `CHANGELOG.md`. Because the core accumulation logic was never implemented, the new tests will fail. Furthermore, the test file itself has bugs: `scriptedProviderWithUsage` yields an extra `{type: 'stop', stopReason: 'end_turn', usage}` chunk after already yielding `STOP_FOR_TOOL`, which overwrites the `tool_use` stop reason with `end_turn` and prevents the tool loop from continuing, plus it leaves an unused `SendMessageParams` import that would fail the linter.
